faq: Is Babu a government website?
No. BabuIndia is an independent project. It is not run, funded or endorsed by the Government of India or any state government. For official services, always use the linked government portal.
Why the name ‘Babu’?
In India, ‘babu’ is the everyday word for a government clerk. Our Babu is the helpful kind — no queue, no token, no ‘come back tomorrow’.
Is it free?
Yes. No ads, no paid listings, no agents or middlemen.
Will Babu ask for my Aadhaar number or OTP?
Never. Babu doesn’t need your Aadhaar, PAN, OTP, passwords or bank details. If anyone claiming to be Babu asks for them, it’s a scam.
Where does my question go?
Nowhere. Babu matches your question to a service right here in your browser. It isn’t sent to us or stored.
How do I spot a fake government website?
Check the address bar. Real government sites end in .gov.in or .nic.in. Fakes often tack extra words on the end — like dc.crsorgi.gov.in.something.in. Babu only links to the real addresses.
Can Babu send me to the wrong page?
It can pick the wrong service, and government sites change. Check that the page you land on is what you need. Links were last reviewed in {d}.
Who translated Babu into my language?

AI did. The translations were checked automatically for completeness, script and matching, but not by native speakers, so some wording may be wrong or awkward. If something seems unclear, switch to English or check the official website.
Which languages does Babu speak?
English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Bengali and Odia — with more Indian languages on the way. Pick yours from the language menu at the top.
My state does things differently.
Many services — ration cards, certificates, land records — are run by states. Pick your state (or just mention it, like “ration card in Bihar”) and Babu shows that state’s own portals.

aadhaar-update.t: Update the address or details on your Aadhaar
aadhaar-update.s: Log in to myAadhaar with your Aadhaar number and an OTP, choose the update you need and upload a supporting document. Your address can be updated online; for a new mobile number, photo or fingerprints you need to visit an Aadhaar centre.

aadhaar-download.s: On myAadhaar, choose Download Aadhaar and enter your Aadhaar or enrolment number and the OTP. You get a password-protected PDF.

aadhaar-status.t: Check your Aadhaar enrolment or update status
aadhaar-status.s: On myAadhaar, choose Check Enrolment & Update Status and enter your enrolment ID or Update Request Number (URN).

aadhaar-centre.t: Find an Aadhaar centre or book an appointment
aadhaar-centre.s: You need to visit a centre for a new Aadhaar and to change your mobile number, photo or fingerprints. Find one nearby on the map, or book a slot at a UIDAI-run centre.

pan-epan.s: If your Aadhaar has a linked mobile number, you can get a PAN as a PDF in minutes, free of cost. Don’t apply if you already have a PAN — holding two is illegal.

pan-link.s: Link them on the Income Tax e-filing portal, or check whether they’re already linked.

pan-reprint.t: Replace a lost PAN card or correct your details
pan-reprint.s: Apply through the agency that issued your PAN — Protean (formerly NSDL) or UTIITSL. Both are authorised by the Income Tax Department. If you don’t know which, try your PAN on both.

pan-verify.t: Check that a PAN is valid
pan-verify.s: Confirm that a PAN is active and matches the holder’s name and date of birth.

passport-apply.t: Apply for or renew a passport
passport-apply.s: Register on Passport Seva, fill in the form, pay the fee and book a slot at a Passport Seva Kendra or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra. Children need their own passport.

passport-track.s: Use Track Application Status on Passport Seva with your file number and date of birth.

voter-register.s: Fill in Form 6 online on the Voters’ Service Portal. A Booth Level Officer then verifies your details.

voter-search.t: Find your name in the voter list
voter-search.s: Search the electoral roll by EPIC number, personal details or mobile number, and see your polling station.

voter-correct.t: Correct details, shift address or download e-EPIC
voter-correct.s: Use Form 8 to correct your details or shift your address, and download your digital voter ID (e-EPIC).

dl-apply.t: Apply for a learner’s or driving licence, or renew one
dl-apply.s: Choose your state on Sarathi, then apply, pay the fee and book a test slot.

dl-status.s: On Sarathi, choose your state and open Application Status, or look up your licence details.

vehicle-rc.t: RC transfer, vehicle registration and other RTO services
vehicle-rc.s: On Parivahan, open Online Services → Vehicle Related Services and choose your state and RTO.

vehicle-challan.t: Check or pay a traffic challan
vehicle-challan.s: Look up challans by vehicle number, licence number or challan number, and pay online.

ration-card.t: Get a ration card, add members or make changes
ration-card.s: Ration cards are issued by your state. Pick your state from the official list to reach its food department portal.

ration-onorc.t: Use your ration card in another state
ration-onorc.s: Under One Nation One Ration Card, NFSA ration card holders can collect their ration from any fair price shop in the country.

itr-file.s: Log in to the e-filing portal with your PAN, choose File Income Tax Return, and e-verify when you’re done.

tax-refund.s: Log in, then open e-File → Income Tax Returns → View Filed Returns to see the status of your return and refund.

tax-pay.s: Use e-Pay Tax to pay advance tax, self-assessment tax and other dues. You don’t need to log in.

tax-calc.s: Use the Income Tax Department’s official tax calculator.

udyam.s: Udyam registration for micro, small and medium businesses is free and online, using your Aadhaar and PAN.

gst-reg.s: Apply for a new GST registration on the GST portal and track your application.

gst-search.s: Check any business’s GST number, legal name and registration status.

company.s: Companies and LLPs are incorporated online on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) portal.

fssai.s: Food businesses register or get a licence on FoSCoS, the FSSAI portal.

startup.s: Apply for DPIIT startup recognition on Startup India.

gem.s: Register as a seller on the Government e-Marketplace.

birth-death.t: Register a birth or death and get the certificate
birth-death.s: Births and deaths should be registered within 21 days. Many states use the national CRS portal; others have their own, and the CRS site tells you which.

ayushman.t: Check Ayushman Bharat eligibility and get your card
ayushman.s: Log in with your mobile number to see if your family is covered, complete e-KYC and download the Ayushman card.

vay-vandana.t: Free health cover for everyone aged 70+
vay-vandana.s: Every citizen aged 70 or above can get the Ayushman Vay Vandana card, whatever their income. Enrol with Aadhaar e-KYC.

abha.s: A free 14-digit ID that keeps your health records together. Create it with Aadhaar or your driving licence.

pmjay-hospitals.t: Find a hospital that accepts Ayushman Bharat
pmjay-hospitals.s: Search empanelled hospitals by state, district and speciality.

pf-balance.s: Log in with your UAN to view your EPF passbook.

pf-withdraw.s: Log in to the Member portal, go to Online Services → Claim and choose the withdrawal you need. Your UAN must be linked to your Aadhaar and bank account.

pf-transfer.t: Transfer PF to a new employer or activate your UAN
pf-transfer.s: On the Member portal, activate your UAN, update your KYC and transfer your old PF account.

jeevan-pramaan.s: Pensioners can submit a digital life certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) with Aadhaar authentication, including face authentication on a phone.

myscheme.t: Find government schemes you’re eligible for
myscheme.s: Answer a few questions on myScheme to see central and state schemes that fit you.

pm-kisan.t: PM-Kisan: register, complete e-KYC or check your status
pm-kisan.s: Farmers can register, complete e-KYC and check their instalments under Know Your Status.

scholarships.s: Apply for central and many state scholarships on the National Scholarship Portal.

pmay.t: Help with a home: PM Awas Yojana
pmay.s: In towns and cities, apply under PMAY-Urban. In villages, PMAY-Gramin beneficiaries are chosen through surveys and the Gram Sabha — ask your gram panchayat.

ujjwala.s: Women from poor households can apply for a free LPG connection under PM Ujjwala Yojana.

eshram.s: Workers without PF or ESIC — such as labourers, domestic workers and gig workers — can register for free.

vishwakarma.s: Traditional artisans and craftspeople — carpenters, tailors, potters and more — can get training, a toolkit grant and loans.

cyber-fraud.t: Report online fraud or cyber crime
cyber-fraud.s: Lost money to a scam? Call 1930 straight away — acting fast gives the best chance of stopping the money — then file a complaint on the cyber crime portal.

consumer.t: Complain about a product or company
consumer.s: Raise a consumer complaint with the National Consumer Helpline — online or by calling 1915.

cpgrams.s: File a grievance against a central or state government office on CPGRAMS and track it.

rti.s: Ask any central government public authority for information online, for a ₹10 fee. Many states run their own RTI portals.

lost-phone.t: Block a lost or stolen phone
lost-phone.s: Report it to the police, then block the phone on Sanchar Saathi so it can’t be used on any network in India.

sim-check.t: See which SIM cards are in your name, or report fraud calls
sim-check.s: Check the mobile connections issued against your ID, and report suspected fraud calls or messages.

state-certificates.t: Caste, income or domicile certificates, land records, marriage registration
state-certificates.s: These are run by your state government, usually through its e-district or land records portal. Start from the national services directory.

digilocker.t: Keep official documents on your phone (DigiLocker)
digilocker.s: Get digital copies of your driving licence, vehicle RC, marksheets and more, issued directly by the departments.

umang.t: Many government services in one app (UMANG)
umang.s: Use UMANG on the web or as an app for services from central and state departments.

oci.s: Foreign citizens of Indian origin, and foreign spouses of Indian citizens or OCI holders, can apply online.

evisa.s: Foreign nationals can apply online for tourist, business, medical and other e-Visas.

madad.t: Help from an Indian embassy abroad (MADAD)
madad.s: Indians abroad can raise consular problems — emergencies, unpaid wages, bringing home mortal remains — with Indian missions.
